agents.purpose: Analyzes satellite/cadastral imagery, property boundaries, azimuth, tilt angles, and tree/building shading obstacles.
Calculates dead load, snow load (Zone 1-3), wind suction zones (1-4), and foundation point sizing (80x80cm depth 80cm frost-free).
Models string voltages (MPPT 200-800V), inverter sizing ratios (1.10 - 1.25), battery round-trip efficiency, and 22kW wallbox load management.
Generates complete Bill of Materials (BOM), cutting schedules, fastener matrices, § 12 Abs. 3 UStG tax verification, and warehouse allocation.
Runs the Santa Method convergence review and compiles the formal client dossier, CAD schematics, and binding 72h quotation hold.
